task.title: Historical decision record for optional npm digest validation

events.content: Chose the optional digest validation contract

raw.question: How should optional npm digests be validated?
raw.chosen: Require one canonical local/registry digest match and reject malformed or incomparable values
raw.reasoning: Reconciliation safely accepts either canonical SHA-512 SRI or SHA-1 when local and registry share one; the later attestation gate incorrectly demanded both after publication.

events.content: Self-reported, non-gating session note: the agent stated that it aligned attestation and baseline validation with the reconciliation contract and observed the release suite passing. This trajectory captured no command, commit, or changed-file evidence.

retrospective.summary: Historical decision record only: chose to accept an optional npm digest only when the local tarball and registry share one canonical matching value, while refusing malformed or incomparable digests. The stored f811fd48 trace is an earlier PR ancestor, not the current head. This trajectory captured no command, output, commit, changed-file, or test evidence; all implementation and validation statements are self-reported, non-authoritative, and non-gating.
